commits.message:
feat(style): suggest near-miss style and colour names (rich-diagnostics-un7.3)

A style token that no position accepts now names what it most plausibly
meant: `rd` suggests `red`, `bolt` suggests `bold`, `not itallic` suggests
`italic`. Because the suggestion is part of the StyleSyntaxError message,
it reaches onStyleError handlers with no further wiring.

The suggestion is built by the style parser, not the colour parser. Each
position has its own vocabulary: a bare token may be an attribute or a
colour, `on X` only a colour, `not X` only an attribute. Suggesting in
ColorParseError too would print the suggestion twice, because the style
error quotes the colour error. The two could also disagree, since `gold`
is near `bold` as well as the `goldN` colours.

A name counts as a near miss when it is within one edit per three letters,
and never less than one edit. Swapping two neighbouring letters counts as
one edit. Every name tied for nearest is listed, because picking one of a
tie would be a guess. Unrelated words (`notastyle`, `hello`) get no
suggestion.

feat(console): report swallowed style errors through onStyleError (rich-diagnostics-un7.2) (#138)

* feat(console): report swallowed style errors through onStyleError (rich-diagnostics-un7.2)

A misspelled style name in a RichText renders unstyled with no trace, because
text.ts absorbs StyleSyntaxError so a bad style degrades instead of crashing.
That default stays. ConsoleOptions.onStyleError now hears about each absorbed
error, with the whole offending style string, carried to renderables on
RenderOptions beside the theme. A handler that throws makes rendering strict;
strict is a handler value, not a second flag.

* fix(console): state that onStyleError fires per resolution, not per string (rich-diagnostics-un7.2)

Review found a style can resolve twice in one print (a Strip joiner reads an
item's edge style), so "told about each style string" overpromised. Dedup
would need render-scoped state nothing owns; the doc now says what happens
and a test pins it. The new test block moves above the theme-resolution
header it had split from its describe.
